text: Kingsmoor FC’s goal at 82' was a textbook example of effective high pressing and quick transition, initiated by Luca Iversen’s successful tackle deep in their own half, resulting in a high turnover [#1512]. The team efficiently moved the ball wide with just two passes in 9.1 seconds before Mason Morales crossed back for Iversen to score from close range, perfectly utilizing their wide, crossing play style within a 4-4-2 formation [#1513] [#1514]. This moment demonstrated how proactive pressing combined with swift exploitation of wide areas can create clear scoring opportunities, especially against Westport Albion’s more vertical approach which controlled less possession and had fewer touches in the box late in the game. A focused coaching point would be to consistently train the team to press aggressively in their own half to force turnovers, immediately switching to quick wide attacks to capitalize on unsettled defenses.
